purpose: Non-training deterministic history export and availability audit
stream_membership: Every observed canonical network flow in the declared complete capture interval, independent of labels; not just positive or verified-normal rows
raw8_source: The unified network extraction only; do not fill missing measurements using action labels, host truth or HTTP payload lengths
physical_flow_identity: flow_id uniquely identifies a host view. Multiple hosts may view one physical_flow_id within a group; each (physical_flow_id, host) updates once. Host views are not independent flows.
empty_history: Fill all 18 numeric/comparison history positions with zero and set empty_history=1; later genuine missing measurements remain null
transform: log1p of finite nonnegative values; missing stays null

state_per_group_host.previous_completed_record: transformed eight values, available_at, opaque peer key
state_per_group_host.prefix_means: one running mean and nonmissing count per numeric field
state_per_group_host.reset: At declared complete capture boundary; do not merge different sources, sensor duplicates or reserved attack groups

equal_time_rule: Query all records sharing an available_at timestamp before updating any of them; deterministic flow_id order only determines which tied record becomes previous for later times
strict_history_rule: Every contributing record has available_at strictly before the current record
clock_priority: actual detector receipt/export clock when recorded
fixed canonical packet replay export clock
explicit completed-flow offline lower-bound experiment only
forbidden_clock_substitution: Do not replace a missing export clock with flow start; ts+duration alone cannot establish real online detection
explicit_offline_mode: offline_flow_end_replay requires flow_end_at for every input and uses that clock consistently even if some available_at values exist; output states that it is not actual online availability
unavailable_clock_policy: Default error. Explicit block-group emits no context for any group containing a null/absent required clock; audit preserves all blocked view IDs, counts, reason and original missing-clock observations. Invalid non-null clocks still raise.
identity_usage: Opaque host and peer keys are for association only; only same_peer boolean may be emitted
memory_claim: Constant numeric state per observed host; total memory scales with active host count and must be measured, not claimed globally bounded
cold_start: No unobserved earlier traffic is invented; report capture-boundary cold starts
admission: Freeze one canonical flow extraction and available_at field before export. AIT cloud uses independently justified Zeek 8.0.11 -C; keep strict output for extraction audit only.
training_status: Not an F/V/C allocation and not a training launch; current exact-label and calibration identities remain incomplete
stop_condition: If usable history cannot be formed without future records or label-conditioned sampling, do not create a context training arm
